crossToolNote.zh: 无跨工具窥探（keytar 仅存储自身扩展密钥）
crossToolNote.en: None (keytar stores only Gemini CLI's own extension secrets)

hardwareFingerprint.zh: 采集 GPU 型号 (si.graphics()) + 持久化 installation_id
hardwareFingerprint.en: Collects GPU model via systeminformation + persistent installation_id

oneLiner.zh: 默认开启 Google Clearcut 上报 play.googleapis.com（含 GPU 型号与仓库名 SHA-256 哈希）；不认 DO_NOT_TRACK，设置弹窗隐藏开关 (showInDialog: false)，且 GEMINI_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false 关不掉它。
oneLiner.en: Default-on Google Clearcut telemetry to play.googleapis.com (GPU model + hashed GitHub repo name); ignores DO_NOT_TRACK, hides toggle from /settings dialog, and GEMINI_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false does not disable it.

title.zh: Clearcut 默认开启、隐藏在设置弹窗外，且环境变量无法关闭
title.en: Default-on Clearcut hidden from UI dialog with no env var opt-out

summary.zh: privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled 默认为 true 且 showInDialog: false；GEMINI_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false 只控制独立 OTel，不影响 Clearcut 上报。
summary.en: `privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled` defaults to `true` with `showInDialog: false`; `GEMINI_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false` only toggles OpenTelemetry, leaving Clearcut active.

mitigationNote.zh: 必须手动编辑 ~/.gemini/settings.json 将 usageStatisticsEnabled 设为 false。
mitigationNote.en: Manually edit ~/.gemini/settings.json and set privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled to false.
